signature.crystalline_sparkle.light_beha.description: Crystalline theme: prismatic light refraction signature
signature.crystalline_sparkle.light_beha.contents: All surfaces refract light into rainbow prisms. Every crystal splits white light into spectrum. Surfaces covered in micro-facets catching light at different angles. Prismatic halos around each bright point.

signature.crystalline_sparkle.motif.description: Crystalline theme: ice crystal motif signature
signature.crystalline_sparkle.motif.contents: Hexagonal crystal formations throughout design. Six-pointed star patterns in embellishments. Geometric faceted shapes echoing cut gemstones. Sharp angular details contrasting soft fabric.

signature.crystalline_sparkle.color.description: Crystalline theme: prismatic light behavior signature
signature.crystalline_sparkle.color.contents: Surfaces refract light with prismatic shimmer. Opalescent finish with sharp specular overtones. Silver and crystal accents throughout. Clinical sparkle quality.

signature.crystalline_sparkle.texture.description: Crystalline theme: crushed crystal texture signature
signature.crystalline_sparkle.texture.contents: Surfaces appear dusted with crushed diamonds. Crystalline granular texture catches light. Frost-like crystallization on fabric edges. Glassy smooth alternating with granular sparkle.

signature.crystalline_sparkle.compositio.description: Crystalline theme: radiating burst composition signature
signature.crystalline_sparkle.compositio.contents: Crystal elements radiate from central points in starburst patterns. Embellishments arranged in explosive formations. Details concentrate then disperse like frozen fireworks.

signature.romantic_floral.light_behavior.description: Romantic Floral theme: petal shimmer under harsh light
signature.romantic_floral.light_behavior.contents: Fabric surfaces catch harsh overhead LED with petal-like shimmer. Floral elements create sharp specular points. Light reflects off dimensional petals with hard edges. Rose textures visible under clinical brightness.

signature.romantic_floral.motif.description: Romantic Floral theme: cascading roses signature
signature.romantic_floral.motif.contents: Full-bloom roses cascade throughout design. Dimensional petals in graduated sizes. Rose buds mixed with open blooms. Flowing rose vine patterns with curving stems.

signature.romantic_floral.color.description: Romantic Floral theme: garden sunset palette signature
signature.romantic_floral.color.contents: Dusty rose base with peach and coral accents. Sage green secondary tones. Cream highlights throughout. Warm sunset garden colors.

signature.romantic_floral.texture.description: Romantic Floral theme: velvet petal texture signature
signature.romantic_floral.texture.contents: Surfaces have velvet petal texture. Dimensional texture like rose petals. Crinkled areas like dried flowers. Mix of smooth and textured surfaces visible under harsh light.

signature.romantic_floral.composition.description: Romantic Floral theme: trailing garden composition signature
signature.romantic_floral.composition.contents: Flowers trail in natural vine patterns. Asymmetric placement following organic curves. Clusters at shoulders and hips with trails between. Garden-inspired arrangement.

signature.bow_obsession.light_behavior.description: Bow Obsession theme: satin ribbon sheen signature
signature.bow_obsession.light_behavior.contents: Bright satin ribbon sheen on all bow surfaces. High-gloss finish reflects overhead light. Lustrous silk highlights along bow curves. Mirror-like ribbon edges.

signature.bow_obsession.motif.description: Bow Obsession theme: graduated bow cascade signature
signature.bow_obsession.motif.contents: Bows in graduated sizes from 2cm to 30cm. Each bow perfectly tied with symmetrical loops. Multiple bow layers creating depth. Bow tails flowing and interweaving.

signature.bow_obsession.color.description: Bow Obsession theme: ribbon rainbow palette signature
signature.bow_obsession.color.contents: Main dress color with contrasting bow accents. Each bow tier in slightly different shade. Gradient from light to dark in bow cascades. Ribbon edges in metallic accent.

signature.bow_obsession.texture.description: Bow Obsession theme: grosgrain ribbon texture signature
signature.bow_obsession.texture.contents: Mix of grosgrain, satin, and velvet ribbon textures. Ribbed grosgrain alternating with smooth satin. Matte velvet bows contrasting glossy ones. Textural variety in bow materials.

signature.bow_obsession.composition.description: Bow Obsession theme: strategic bow placement signature
signature.bow_obsession.composition.contents: Major bow at shoulder. Secondary bows at neckline edge. Accent bows at bodice center. Bow clusters at visible focal points. Strategic bow placement across visible dress areas.

signature.refined_elegance.light_behavio.description: Refined Elegance theme: pearl luster under harsh light
signature.refined_elegance.light_behavio.contents: Pearl surfaces catch harsh overhead LED with sharp specular points. Iridescent sheen visible under clinical brightness. Nacre surfaces reflecting white-blue light. Pearl highlights create bright focal points.

signature.refined_elegance.motif.description: Refined Elegance theme: delicate pearl clusters signature
signature.refined_elegance.motif.contents: Small pearl clusters at strategic points. Single pearl drops as accents. Pearl strands outlining seams. Graduated pearl sizes for sophistication.

signature.refined_elegance.color.description: Refined Elegance theme: whisper pastel palette signature
signature.refined_elegance.color.contents: Palest pink base with ivory accents. Barely-there lavender secondary. Champagne metallic details. Colors so soft they're almost white.

signature.refined_elegance.texture.description: Refined Elegance theme: silk dupioni texture signature
signature.refined_elegance.texture.contents: Subtle slubbed silk texture throughout. Delicate surface irregularities catch light. Refined matte finish with occasional sheen. Luxurious hand without ostentation.

signature.refined_elegance.composition.description: Refined Elegance theme: minimalist accent placement signature
signature.refined_elegance.composition.contents: Single statement detail at neckline. Subtle accents at cuffs. Delicate trim along hemline. Negative space as design element. Less is more philosophy.

signature.lace_heirloom.light_behavior.description: Lace Heirloom theme: filtered shadow play signature
signature.lace_heirloom.light_behavior.contents: Light filters through lace creating shadow patterns. Delicate shadows on skin beneath lace. Interplay of opacity and transparency. Dappled light effect.

signature.lace_heirloom.motif.description: Lace Heirloom theme: antique medallion signature
signature.lace_heirloom.motif.contents: Large lace medallions at focal points. Intricate Victorian patterns throughout. Scalloped lace edges on every hem. Heritage motifs like fleur-de-lis.

signature.lace_heirloom.color.description: Lace Heirloom theme: aged ivory palette signature
signature.lace_heirloom.color.contents: Antique ivory base with ecru accents. Tea-stained beige secondary tones. Vintage cream throughout. Colors of aged heirloom textiles.

signature.lace_heirloom.texture.description: Lace Heirloom theme: layered lace depth signature
signature.lace_heirloom.texture.contents: Multiple lace layers creating dimensional depth. Raised cordwork on flat lace base. Mix of Chantilly, Alençon, and Venice laces. Textural variety through lace types.

signature.lace_heirloom.composition.description: Lace Heirloom theme: symmetrical vintage placement signature
signature.lace_heirloom.composition.contents: Mirrored lace placement on bodice. Centered medallion at neckline. Symmetrical sleeve details. Balanced hem decoration. Classic heirloom arrangement.

signature.glitter_abundance.light_behavi.description: Glitter Abundance theme: disco ball reflection signature
signature.glitter_abundance.light_behavi.contents: Every surface throws sparkles like disco ball. Thousands of tiny light points dancing. Glitter particles visible in air around dress. Maximum light scatter effect.

signature.glitter_abundance.motif.description: Glitter Abundance theme: layered sparkle buildup signature
signature.glitter_abundance.motif.contents: Glitter applied in multiple layers. Chunky glitter over fine glitter base. Holographic particles mixed with metallic. Different glitter sizes creating depth.

signature.glitter_abundance.color.description: Glitter Abundance theme: sparkle intensity signature
signature.glitter_abundance.color.contents: Glitter particles catch light with holographic shimmer. Iridescent sparkle accents throughout. Silver and gold glitter mixed. Multi-point light reflections at every angle.

signature.glitter_abundance.texture.description: Glitter Abundance theme: encrusted surface texture signature
signature.glitter_abundance.texture.contents: Surfaces completely encrusted with glitter. Rough granular texture from particle buildup. No smooth areas remaining. Glitter crust on every surface.

signature.glitter_abundance.composition.description: Glitter Abundance theme: gradient density composition signature
signature.glitter_abundance.composition.contents: Heaviest glitter concentration at shoulders. Gradient reducing toward hem. Strategic buildup at focal points. Glitter pooling in fabric folds.

signature.gingham_tradition.light_behavi.description: Gingham Tradition theme: crisp cotton shine signature
signature.gingham_tradition.light_behavi.contents: Clean cotton sheen on checked fabric. Bright whites in check pattern catch light. Matte squares alternating with slight sheen. Fresh laundered appearance.

signature.gingham_tradition.motif.description: Gingham Tradition theme: classic check pattern signature
signature.gingham_tradition.motif.contents: Perfect 1cm gingham checks throughout. Checks align at all seams precisely. Black and white or navy and white checks. Picnic blanket perfection.

signature.gingham_tradition.color.description: Gingham Tradition theme: americana color palette signature
signature.gingham_tradition.color.contents: Navy blue and white base. Red ribbon accents. Yellow detail touches. Classic americana picnic colors. Clean graphic contrast.

signature.gingham_tradition.texture.description: Gingham Tradition theme: crisp woven texture signature
signature.gingham_tradition.texture.contents: Crisp woven cotton texture visible. Slight stiffness from starch. Clean pressed finish. Structured fabric holding shape.

signature.gingham_tradition.composition.description: Gingham Tradition theme: bias trim placement signature
signature.gingham_tradition.composition.contents: Bias-cut check trim on straight edges. Diagonal checks meeting straight checks. Chevron effects at seam intersections. Graphic pattern play.

signature.celestial_fantasy.light_behavi.description: Celestial Fantasy theme: star point sparkle under harsh light
signature.celestial_fantasy.light_behavi.contents: Tiny sharp points of light like stars under harsh LED. Constellation patterns of bright specular points. Star elements catching clinical overhead light with hard sparkle. Multiple pinpoint reflections.

signature.celestial_fantasy.motif.description: Celestial Fantasy theme: moon and stars signature
signature.celestial_fantasy.motif.contents: Crescent moons and star clusters throughout. Constellation patterns embroidered. Shooting star trails in embellishments. Celestial bodies as focal points.

signature.celestial_fantasy.color.description: Celestial Fantasy theme: midnight sky palette signature
signature.celestial_fantasy.color.contents: Deep midnight blue base. Silver star accents. Pale moon yellow touches. Purple nebula undertones. Night sky gradient colors.

signature.celestial_fantasy.texture.description: Celestial Fantasy theme: ethereal float texture signature
signature.celestial_fantasy.texture.contents: Fabric appears weightless and floating. Sheer layers creating misty effect. Gossamer light materials. Cloud-like softness throughout.

signature.celestial_fantasy.composition.description: Celestial Fantasy theme: constellation mapping signature
signature.celestial_fantasy.composition.contents: Embellishments placed in constellation patterns. Major stars at focal points. Comet streak accents across bodice. Celestial map across visible dress surface.
